feature_queries.name: review_lifecycle
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  MIN(review_time) AS first_review_time,
  MAX(review_time) AS last_review_time,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(review_time), timestamp) AS days_since_first_review,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(review_time), timestamp) AS days_since_last_review,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(review_time), MAX(review_time)) AS span_days
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_counts_multiwin
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time, r.rating, r.verified
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(review_time) AS n_reviews_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_180d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_365d,
  AVG(rating) AS rating_mean_total,
  STDDEV_SAMP(rating) AS rating_std_total,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN rating ELSE NULL END) AS rating_mean_90d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN rating ELSE NULL END) AS rating_mean_365d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS verified_rate_total,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN (CASE WHEN verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) ELSE NULL END) AS verified_rate_90d
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_ratios
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    timestamp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_7d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_180d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_reviews_365d
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY product_id, timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  (n_reviews_7d * 1.0) / NULLIF(n_reviews_30d,0) AS frac_7_of_30,
  (n_reviews_30d * 1.0) / NULLIF(n_reviews_90d,0) AS frac_30_of_90,
  (n_reviews_90d * 1.0) / NULLIF(n_reviews_180d,0) AS frac_90_of_180,
  (n_reviews_90d * 1.0) / NULLIF(n_reviews_365d,0) AS frac_90_of_365
FROM counts

feature_queries.name: review_accel_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
), counts AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    timestamp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n7,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n30,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n90,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n365,
    MAX(review_time) AS last_review_time
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY product_id, timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  (n30 * 1.0) - (n90 * (30.0/90.0)) AS accel_30_vs_90,
  (n90 * 1.0) - (n365 * (90.0/365.0)) AS accel_90_vs_365,
  CASE WHEN (n90 - n30) > 0 AND n7 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_30_90_but_zero_7,
  CASE WHEN n30 > 0 AND DATE_DIFF('day', last_review_time, timestamp) > 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_30_but_gap_gt14,
  CASE WHEN n90 > 0 AND DATE_DIFF('day', last_review_time, timestamp) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_90_but_gap_gt30
FROM counts

feature_queries.name: rating_polarity_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time, r.rating
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_low_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_high_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rating <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_low_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' AND rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_high_365d
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: customer_diversity
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.customer_id, r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n_customers_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN customer_id ELSE NULL END) AS n_customers_90d
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_gap_features
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT e.product_id, e.timestamp, r.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    timestamp,
    review_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, timestamp ORDER BY review_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM joined
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    timestamp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN review_time END) AS t1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN review_time END) AS t2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=3 THEN review_time END) AS t3,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn=4 THEN review_time END) AS t4
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 4
  GROUP BY product_id, timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  DATE_DIFF('day', t2, t1) AS gap_1_2_days,
  DATE_DIFF('day', t3, t2) AS gap_2_3_days,
  DATE_DIFF('day', t4, t3) AS gap_3_4_days,
  (DATE_DIFF('day', t2, t1) + DATE_DIFF('day', t3, t2) + DATE_DIFF('day', t4, t3)) / 3.0 AS mean_gap_last4
FROM pivoted

feature_queries.name: text_activity_recent
feature_queries.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.timestamp,
    r.review_time,
    r.review_text,
    r.summary
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review r
    ON r.product_id = e.product_id
   AND r.review_time <= e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN LENGTH(COALESCE(review_text,'')) ELSE NULL END) AS review_text_len_mean_90d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN LENGTH(COALESCE(summary,'')) ELSE NULL END) AS summary_len_mean_90d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN LENGTH(COALESCE(review_text,'')) ELSE NULL END) AS review_text_len_mean_365d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN LENGTH(COALESCE(summary,'')) ELSE NULL END) AS summary_len_mean_365d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN (CASE WHEN review_text IS NULL OR review_text='' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) ELSE NULL END) AS frac_empty_review_text_90d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_time > timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN (CASE WHEN summary IS NULL OR summary='' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) ELSE NULL END) AS frac_empty_summary_90d
FROM joined
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: product_static_plus
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.product_id,
  e.timestamp,
  p.price AS price,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.brand,'')) AS brand_len,
  CASE WHEN p.brand IS NULL OR p.brand='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS brand_missing,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.title,'')) AS title_len,
  LENGTH(COALESCE(p.description,'')) AS desc_len,
  ARRAY_LENGTH(p.category) AS category_depth
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = e.product_id
